During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], this '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' commanded [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] renewed assault on the [[B'omarr Monastery]]. They had been ordered by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], upon the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] Republic warships arriving at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], to hold off the invading force until her mission had been completed, to which the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] complied with the order, and proceeded to scramble the Separatist forces' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons.
